def calculate_mean_daily_energy(file_path):
    # Load the dataset
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Ensure the date column is of datetime type
    df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
    
    # Set the Date column as the index
    df.set_index('Date', inplace=True)
    
    # Resample to sum the energy used on a daily basis
    daily_energy = df['WholeBuildingEnergy'].resample('D').sum()
    
    # Filter out only the weekdays
    weekdays = daily_energy['Monday':'Friday']
    
    # Calculate the mean daily energy in Joules
    mean_energy = weekdays.mean() * 3600000 
    
    return mean_energy
